cases.title: With the Settings tick ON, a ROTATE Copy of pit P3 about a point 5 m away (so the copy lands elsewhere) comes with its own PIT LABEL and cover text
cases.plan_item: COPY of a pit (triage group M3; daily card D15); BUG-665 with the switch ON
cases.expected: (First result, b3v2 of 25 Oct 2026 on Civil 3.0.75: the copy gets the "numbered as new" line and a pit block but NO PIT LABEL and NO cover text, also when the copy lands 5 m away, so the missing label belongs to ROTATE Copy itself, not to a copy sitting on top of its original; the case is tagged EXPECT-FAIL BUG-665.) With the tick ON when AutoCAD starts, ROTATE Copy of P3 by 90 degrees about 58777.7,-25569.9 prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new." and adds one pit block, one PIT LABEL block and one cover text (CL ...) for the copy. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The copy clean-up runs when AutoCAD ends the native ROTATE command on the live drawing, and the switch is read from the real settings file when AutoCAD starts.
not_automated: Grip Ctrl-drag copy is not driven. The copy's number is not read here (R34sn reads the COPY and SCALE numbers).
